statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and presyncope
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated for further diagnostic evaluation
The diagnoses are I49.5 and R55
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
